rules.text: Applies to units whose card names Survivor. During force set-up every Unique model takes one extra armor boost token on top of any it would normally receive. Non-Unique Survivors get none from this card.
Applies to units whose card names Super Mutant. When one fires a ranged weapon during close combat it tests with its Melee value.
These models may never wear Power Armor.
These models take no radiation damage.
Food and drink eaten by these models always counts as cooked.

name: Brotherhood of Steel

rules.text: Leader activation start: 1 Reaction token to an untokened friend in Leader Presence.

source: ERR p.19-20 (version 2 addition only; the card itself is not in the free CARDS file)

name: General Reference

rules.text: Reference: the Actions are Move, Charge, Close Combat, Shoot, Throw, Expertise and Prepare; the matching AP-use icons are Movement, Attack, Expertise and Prepare.
Reference: at one ruler length, any action (not Prepare) or a friendly model being hit triggers a reaction; at two lengths only movements and attacks do. LoS is needed except for attacks.

source: ERR p.2 (attacks need no LoS to trigger)

rules.text: Factionless dog adopts the Leader's faction.
Dogs can never gain the Lockpick or Computers skills.
Dogs: only food/drink or items naming dogs.
Creatures can never gain the Lockpick or Computers skills.
Creatures need a faction matching the Leader (unless agreed).
